messages:
Tess (CSM): Heads-up — Mira says Week1 onboarding hit a few things: CloudWatch audit logs not showing, KMS Decrypt sporadic, IAM role can't assume cross-account. Not an outage but a churn risk if onboarding drags. Can we triage now?
Arjun (NetEng): I'll look at VPC peering & NAT. Quick check: MTU mismatch observed on the tunnel and their firewall is not SNATing return traffic for 10.18.0.0/22 -> packets dropped.
Clara (Security): I pulled KMS logs: key policy only allows the customer's management account but their CI runs in a different account. Key policy must include the deploy role or we should issue a grant. Also their role trust lacks an ExternalId condition — sec review flagged that.
Nate (Onboard): Launching validation: `./validate_onboard --customer rowan --checks vpc,kms,iam,logs` — will post results.
DeployBot: run #7102 started for rowan onboarding checks — ETA ~2m
Nate (Onboard): results: vpc FAIL -> MTU mismatch + missing SNAT for return path; kms FAIL -> AccessDenied on Encrypt/Decrypt due to key policy; iam WARN -> trust exists but missing ExternalId condition; audit-logs WARN -> logs exist but retention = 7d, customer expects 90d.
Tess (CSM): Commercial note: Rowan's renewal review window opens at day 30; they said onboarding speed affects expansion. Let's avoid making this a renewal discussion. If not green within 48h we'll escalate and open a customer success watch.
Arjun (NetEng): Quick mitigation: request they set MTU 1420 on tunnel endpoints and add SNAT for 10.18.0.0/22 on egress. I'll paste Forti/Juniper commands in DM and take network 48h watch.
Clara (Security): Sending options to Mira: (1) update key policy to add `arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/rowan-deploy` with kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey; or (2) create a one-off grant scoped to that role. Also ask them to set ExternalId and share it. I'll verify no org-level deny (SCP).
Nate (Onboard): If they accept a grant I'll re-run validation. For logs I can add a runbook snippet to set S3 lifecycle -> Glacier/90d and offer to help apply it.
Tess (CSM): Actions: Arjun -> paste commands + confirm with customer (ETA 20m). Clara -> send key-policy/grant options + confirm ExternalId (ETA 30m). Nate -> prep runbook snippet for 90d retention & re-run (ETA after fixes). Tess -> flag CRM watch (48h) and schedule check-in with Mira in 24h. Owners?
Arjun (NetEng): Owning network 48h watch. I'll update the runbook with MTU note.
Clara (Security): Owning KMS/IAM follow-through. I'll add org-SCP check.
Nate (Onboard): Will add log retention template to onboarding doc and automation for grants.
Mira (rowan-cust): Thanks — we applied MTU 1420 and added SNAT, created a temporary grant for the deploy role, ExternalId set to `rowan-external-987`. Standing by for re-run. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: run #7102 completed — summary: vpc PASS, kms PASS (grant), iam PASS (ExternalId present), audit-logs WARN -> retention still 7d on source bucket.
Nate (Onboard): re-run: functional except logs retention. Created PR in their infra repo to add lifecycle rule to Glacier/90d. Once merged we'll mark onboarding green. Validation logs uploaded: http://redwood.internal/onboard/rowan/validation-4951236789
Tess (CSM): Great. I'll note this positive in CRM and keep 48h watch for retention confirmation. Also capturing feedback: add an onboarding UI step for cross-account KMS grants and a template ExternalId generator. Please add UX items to backlog. :rocket:
Clara (Security): Adding backlog tickets: KMS cross-account grant helper + ExternalId UX.
